name: Can I replace cabinet hinges with a different type, like soft-close?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace cabinet hinges with a different type, like soft-close?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can often upgrade your cabinet hinges to a different type, such as soft-close hinges, even if your existing cabinets didn't have them. This upgrade provides a quieter and more controlled closing action. However, the feasibility depends on your cabinet's construction and door style. Some retrofits are straightforward, while others may require minor modifications or specific hinge types designed for your cabinet overlay (e.g., full overlay, partial overlay, inset). It's best to have a professional assess your cabinets to ensure proper fit and function for the new hinges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, it's often possible to upgrade to soft-close hinges, but feasibility depends on your cabinet construction and door style. Professional assessment ensures proper fit.
